note: Behavioral evals testing critical CAF authoring, UI lookup, SpEL interaction, SAS/CAS compute, and BIRD XML template invariants.

evals.prompt: In my 3-step custom CAF model, Step 2 parameters (SM_ASSET_VARIABLE as SINGLESELECT, INPUTVARS as MULTISELECT, TARGETVAR as SINGLESELECT, and STABLE_PERIOD as STABLEPERIOD) are saved in PostgreSQL, but whenever I open Step 2 in the AIoT browser UI, SM_ASSET_VARIABLE, INPUTVARS, and TARGETVAR appear blank and STABLE_PERIOD shows no chart. Why?
evals.expected_output: Explains that RESOLVEONUI=true was set on SINGLESELECT/MULTISELECT lookups (or #ctx.getCurrentStep() guarded initial cascades). In app.js fetchPossibleValues, every control except STABLEPERIOD and MULTIINPCHKTABLE intersects currentValues with /possibleValues keys; returning the 6 RESOLVEONUI metadata keys wipes currentValues to [] on step open.
expectations: Identifies RESOLVEONUI=true on SINGLESELECT and MULTISELECT lookups as the root cause wiping currentValues to [] in app.js fetchPossibleValues
Instructs removing RESOLVEONUI from SINGLESELECT, MULTISELECT, and DROPDOWN lookups while keeping RESOLVEONUI=true strictly on STABLEPERIOD
Checks that lookup cascade <Interactions> keep <Condition></Condition> empty rather than guarding with #ctx.getCurrentStep() (which returns '' on initial step open)

evals.prompt: Why did my CAF Step 1 SAS job fail on %qas_getconnections(g_cas=?g_cas, g_metadata=?g_metadata) with a syntax error showing literal '?g_cas' in the SAS log?
evals.expected_output: The AIoT mid-tier replaces ?g_cas, ?analysisID, ?g_metadata, ?limit, ?append, and ?filter only once at their very first occurrence in <Code>, including inside SAS /* ... */ comments.
expectations: Explains first-occurrence one-shot substitution by the AIoT mid-tier
Points out that mentioning ?g_cas or ?analysisID in a header comment consumes the substitution
Advises removing all literal ?token strings from comments

evals.prompt: My CAF Step 2 saves an ASTORE named ISOLATION_&G_ASSET_VARIABLE._AST2_&g_instance_nm in QASAnlOut. It failed on asset IDCP_CH18B with 'ERROR: Invalid data set name', and on shorter assets re-running Step 1 crashed in accessControl.updSomeAcsTable. How do I fix both?
evals.expected_output: ISOLATION_IDCP_CH18B_AST2_<8char> is 34 characters (> SAS 32-char dataset limit), and custom Step 2 tables/sashdat files need _&g_instance_nm strictly at the end plus an isolated Step 1 PROC CAS pre-cleanup (dropTable with remACs=true + deleteSource).
expectations: Calculates the 32-character SAS dataset name limit violation (34 > 32)
Proposes deterministic <=8-char CRC32 asset key compression keeping _&g_instance_nm strictly last
Provides Step 1 pre-cleanup dropping *_${shortId} tables with remACs=true and deleting .sashdat sources while preserving options sessref

evals.prompt: How should Step 2 and Step 3 SAS code parse STABLE_PERIOD and SCORE_PERIOD when STABLE_PERIOD is optional and users can pick 3 windows in Step 2 and 2 windows in Step 3?
evals.expected_output: Read param_value_txt directly from mfgapp.analysis_ins_step_input (avoiding $100 truncation), fall back to (1=1) when %length(%superq(G_STABLE_PERIOD))=0, and loop with %scan(%superq(G_STABLE_PERIOD), &i., %str(,)) to build disjunctive (DATETIME ge ... and DATETIME le ...) OR clauses.
expectations: Reads STABLE_PERIOD / SCORE_PERIOD from mfgapp.analysis_ins_step_input via PROC SQL without $100 truncation
Handles optional empty STABLE_PERIOD cleanly with (1=1)
Uses %superq or %nrbquote with explicit %str(,) in %scan so commas between windows never cause macro argument errors

evals.prompt: My CAF step completed with 0 SAS errors and promoted DEMO_SUMMARY_A1B2C3D4 to QASAnlOut, and I replaced CasResource table="{{.SUMMARY}}" in the BIRD XML, but the Visual Analytics report is still blank.
evals.expected_output: Two checks: both DataSource/@label and CasResource/@table must be tokenized to {{.SUMMARY}} (via templatize_va_report), and the step must publish SUMMARY in outputParams (via %afi_caf_postprocess / build_output_contract or POST .../outputParams).
expectations: Verifies token/producer symmetry via build_output_contract / outputParams and validate_analysis_type_spec
Recommends templatize_va_report instead of manual BIRD XML edits

evals.prompt: I sent a PUT /iotAnalysis/analyses/{id} request with all 3 steps [step1, step2, step3] to update Step 2's STABLE_PERIOD, got HTTP 200, and Step 2 still has the old STABLE_PERIOD. Why?
evals.expected_output: sas-iot-analysis PUT /iotAnalysis/analyses/{id} only persists inputParameters updates on steps[0] in the request payload while leaving other steps untouched in PostgreSQL; use update_analysis_step_parameters_tool or send {"steps": [step2]}.
expectations: Explains the steps[0]-only persistence behavior of PUT /iotAnalysis/analyses/{id}
Recommends update_analysis_step_parameters_tool (or sending only the target step as steps[0])
